response.overview: Two years ago, something happened in the lives of a group of friends—something they agreed never to speak of again.  Years later, they reunite. But this time, their reunion begins with an anonymous letter, revealing one undeniable truth: the past has not been forgotten, and someone is determined to make them pay for what happened all those years ago.  But what really happened two years ago?  And if they all believed the story was already over… who has returned to bring it to an end?
response.title: Through Other Eyes
